item_name: Rothco Thin Red Line Long Sleeve T-shirt
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Thin Red Line Long Sleeve T-Shirt is a tribute to the brave firefighters and first responders who risk their lives in the face of danger. Featuring a distressed U.S. flag graphic with a bold red line, this shirt represents camaraderie, sacrifice, and honor. Made from a soft yet durable cotton / polyester fabric blend, the shirt offers comfort for everyday wear. The tagless neck label adds an extra layer of comfort, eliminating any irritation while wearing.
description: Rothco’s Thin Red Line Long Sleeve T-Shirt is a tribute to the brave firefighters and first responders who risk their lives in the face of danger. Featuring a distressed U.S. flag graphic with a bold red line, this shirt represents camaraderie, sacrifice, and honor.
